ground_truth.subject: cookie:sid
ground_truth.meaning: POST /api/auth/login sets an HttpOnly sid cookie (Path=/, SameSite=Lax) used as the session identifier.

ground_truth.subject: header:X-CSRF-Token
ground_truth.meaning: POST, PATCH, PUT, and DELETE under /api require header X-CSRF-Token equal to csrfToken from login or GET /api/auth/session. GET does not send it.

ground_truth.subject: POST /api/auth/login
ground_truth.meaning: Login is the only mutating /api route that does not require a CSRF header.

ground_truth.subject: POST /api/auth/login
ground_truth.meaning: Unknown email or wrong password returns 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS with a generic message.

ground_truth.subject: /api/*
ground_truth.meaning: Any /api request except POST /api/auth/login without a valid sid cookie returns 401 UNAUTHENTICATED.

ground_truth.subject: header:X-CSRF-Token
ground_truth.meaning: Mutating requests with a missing or mismatched CSRF header return 403 CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID.

ground_truth.subject: order.statusId
ground_truth.meaning: There is no GET /api/order-statuses (or similar) endpoint. Labels exist only in the UI and must be inferred by correlating select values, badges, and JSON statusId.

ground_truth.subject: PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status
ground_truth.meaning: A disallowed statusId returns 409 with currentStatusId and requestedStatusId. The UI only offers allowed buttons, so this error is not produced by ordinary clicks.

ground_truth.subject: POST /api/orders
ground_truth.meaning: Newly created orders have statusId 10 (Draft) and paymentStatus unpaid.

ground_truth.subject: order.paymentStatus
ground_truth.meaning: No payment recorded. Default for new and draft seed orders.

ground_truth.subject: order.paymentStatus
ground_truth.meaning: Payment recorded. Dashboard revenue only counts paid orders that are not Draft or Cancelled.

ground_truth.subject: order.paymentStatus
ground_truth.meaning: Payment refunded. Seed order 1009 is cancelled and refunded.

ground_truth.subject: shipping.methodId
ground_truth.meaning: Canada Standard. Price 799 cents, or 0 when item subtotal >= 10000 cents. estimatedDays [3,5].

ground_truth.subject: shipping.methodId
ground_truth.meaning: Canada Express. Price 1599 cents. estimatedDays [1,2].

ground_truth.subject: shipping.methodId
ground_truth.meaning: United States Ground. Price 899 cents. estimatedDays [5,7].

ground_truth.subject: shipping.methodId
ground_truth.meaning: United States Express. Price 1899 cents. estimatedDays [2,3]. Distinct from CA Express (methodId 2) despite the same display name.

ground_truth.subject: shipping.methodId
ground_truth.meaning: Shipping methods are not catalog entities. POST /api/shipping/options computes options from the address country and the cart subtotal.

ground_truth.subject: shipping.methodId=1.priceCents
ground_truth.meaning: Canadian Standard shipping is free when subtotalCents >= 10000 ($100).

ground_truth.subject: quote.taxCents
ground_truth.meaning: Tax is computed on subtotal plus shipping, not on subtotal alone. No taxRate field is returned.

ground_truth.subject: tax.rate
ground_truth.meaning: Ontario tax rate is 13%.

ground_truth.subject: tax.rate
ground_truth.meaning: British Columbia tax rate is 12%.

ground_truth.subject: tax.rate
ground_truth.meaning: Alberta tax rate is 5%.

ground_truth.subject: tax.rate
ground_truth.meaning: Other Canadian regions, including Quebec (QC), use 5%.

ground_truth.subject: tax.rate
ground_truth.meaning: Non-Canadian destinations, including US, have taxCents 0.

ground_truth.subject: *Cents
ground_truth.meaning: All money fields are integer cents. The UI formats them as USD.

ground_truth.subject: POST /api/orders.quoteId
ground_truth.meaning: Creating an order requires quoteId from POST /api/order-quotes. Client-computed totals are not accepted.

ground_truth.subject: order_quotes.used_at
ground_truth.meaning: A quote can create only one order. Reuse returns 409 QUOTE_ALREADY_USED.

ground_truth.subject: order_quotes.expires_at
ground_truth.meaning: Quotes expire about 10 minutes after creation. Expired quotes return 410 QUOTE_EXPIRED.

ground_truth.subject: order.orderNumber
ground_truth.meaning: New order numbers are ORD-2026- concatenated with the numeric id. The year is hardcoded, not taken from the clock.

ground_truth.subject: order.customerNameSnapshot
ground_truth.meaning: Orders store customerNameSnapshot, customerEmailSnapshot, addressSnapshot, and per-item sku/name/price snapshots that do not change if the live customer or product is later edited.

ground_truth.subject: products.stockQty
ground_truth.meaning: Creating an order decrements product stock by each line quantity.

ground_truth.subject: products.stockQty
ground_truth.meaning: Deleting a draft order adds line quantities back to product stock.

ground_truth.subject: GET /api/orders/{id}
ground_truth.meaning: Order GET does not include activity. Activity is GET /api/orders/{id}/activity.

ground_truth.subject: POST /api/orders/{id}/notes
ground_truth.meaning: Adding a note writes order_notes and an activity event eventType=NOTE_ADDED with data.body. There is no GET notes list.

ground_truth.subject: activity.eventType
ground_truth.meaning: Emitted when an order is created.

ground_truth.subject: activity.eventType
ground_truth.meaning: Emitted on status change. data contains fromStatusId and toStatusId.

ground_truth.subject: activity.eventType
ground_truth.meaning: Emitted when a note is added. data.body is the note text.

ground_truth.subject: DELETE /api/orders/{id}
ground_truth.meaning: Only statusId 10 (Draft) orders can be deleted. Others return 409 ORDER_CANNOT_BE_DELETED. The UI hides the button unless status is Draft.

ground_truth.subject: GET /api/customers?archived
ground_truth.meaning: archived=false is Active, true is Archived, omitted is All. Invalid strings are ignored.

ground_truth.subject: GET /api/customers/suggest
ground_truth.meaning: Suggest returns only non-archived customers, unlike the collection endpoint.

ground_truth.subject: DELETE /api/customers/{id}
ground_truth.meaning: Customers with any order row cannot be deleted. Archive instead.

ground_truth.subject: customer.archived
ground_truth.meaning: PATCH archived=true is reversible via archived=false. Historical orders and snapshots are unchanged.

ground_truth.subject: POST /api/order-quotes
ground_truth.meaning: Archived customers cannot receive new quotes or orders (422). Create-order suggest hides them, so the UI happy path never sends this.

ground_truth.subject: customer.email
ground_truth.meaning: Customer email is unique. Duplicate create/patch returns 409 EMAIL_EXISTS.

ground_truth.subject: version
ground_truth.meaning: Customer PATCH and order status PATCH require the current version. Stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with currentVersion.

ground_truth.subject: GET /api/customers/{customerId}/addresses
ground_truth.meaning: Addresses are scoped to customerId. Quote creation also requires the address to belong to that customer.

ground_truth.subject: GET /api/regions?country
ground_truth.meaning: Regions are loaded after country selection. Empty country returns []. regionId posted with an address must belong to countryCode.

ground_truth.subject: GET /api/products?q
ground_truth.meaning: q matches product name or sku ILIKE.

ground_truth.subject: GET /api/products?active
ground_truth.meaning: Availability filter. Omitted means all.

ground_truth.subject: GET /api/products/suggest
ground_truth.meaning: Suggest returns only active products. Inactive SKU-213 never appears in create-order autocomplete.

ground_truth.subject: POST /api/order-quotes
ground_truth.meaning: quantity > stockQty returns 409 OUT_OF_STOCK with productId, availableQty, requestedQty. Seed product 210 has stock 0 and is still suggestable because it is active.

ground_truth.subject: POST /api/order-quotes
ground_truth.meaning: Inactive products cannot be quoted. The create-order UI cannot select them via suggest.

ground_truth.subject: query.page
ground_truth.meaning: page is 1-based. Invalid values fall back to 1. List UIs reset page to 1 when search text changes.

ground_truth.subject: query.pageSize
ground_truth.meaning: Default and UI list size is 20, max 100. Dashboard recent orders uses pageSize=5.

ground_truth.subject: GET /api/customers/suggest
ground_truth.meaning: Customer and product suggest endpoints cap results at 10.

ground_truth.subject: ui.search
ground_truth.meaning: List and suggest search inputs debounce 250ms before requesting.

ground_truth.subject: GET /api/dashboard/summary?period
ground_truth.meaning: period is an Nd day window. Missing or unparsable values become 30. The UI always sends 30d.

ground_truth.subject: dashboard.revenueCents
ground_truth.meaning: Revenue and paid-order count sum orders in the window with paymentStatus=paid and statusId not in {10 Draft, 50 Cancelled}. This is not the sum of the recent-orders table.

ground_truth.subject: dashboard.customerCount
ground_truth.meaning: customerCount is the number of non-archived customers, not limited to the period window.

ground_truth.subject: dashboard.ordersByStatus
ground_truth.meaning: ordersByStatus counts every order in the window grouped by statusId, including Draft and Cancelled.
